description: This file is a shell script library containing functions and setup logic shared by all CI scripts in the project. It manages CI environment differences, handles build skipping logic, manages groups for logging, and sets up environment variables for CI build processes.

methods.name: begin_group
methods.description: Starts a new log group for CI output, with specific handling for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI, or a no-op for other environments.

methods.name: end_group
methods.description: Ends a log group started by begin_group, with corresponding environment-specific behavior.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Wrapper function to manage a log group around a command execution.
